en: A multi-view color postcard composed of nine photographs bordered by yellow lines, showcasing picturesque half-timbered houses, canals with flowered bridges, and historic buildings in a European town. At the top center, in large decorative red Gothic-style letters, appears the word "Colmar." The architecture is Alsatian, with steep tiled roofs, wooden beams, and flower boxes on windows. Several images show squares, old civic buildings, arcades, and waterfront scenes, all under clear blue skies.
